title: Grateful Dead Live at Avalon Ballroom on 1969-01-25

ai_review.summary: Decent recording featuring excellent jams, highlighted by a terrific Alligator → Feedback sequence.
ai_review.review: The show delivers several excellent jams with a particularly strong Alligator into Feedback segment, though the early new‑tune renditions are noted as rough. Reviewers did not comment on any audio flaws, suggesting the tape is at least listenable. Overall it’s a solid performance that merits a good rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Single 4‑star review emphasizes strong jams and standout Alligator>Feedback; no recording complaints, but limited data yields low confidence.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Review does not mention sound clarity or mix issues; implies the recording is acceptable for listening.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Rough early renditions of new tunes give way to solid jams later in the set.
